'''Outpost 17''' was a remote station in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Durace]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==History==
During the [[New Republic era]], Outpost 17 was constructed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet Durace, to allow [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to study the world's weather and topographical phenomena from a safe distance. It was also a supply port for [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who were working in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TUR" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the outpost was destroyed and a number of legends spread regarding what had happened to the facility's remains. The stories claimed that the outpost had crashed onto Durace, and that it contained a valuable treasure. Some of the tales claimed that the treasure was a valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]], while in others, it was said to be [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|the lightsaber]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="TUR" />
